howto: Tap Play, then read the one-card tutorial on your first run.
Drag or aim with the mouse to steer into orbs and away from walls and bodies.
Hold Shift or Space to boost, then tap Play again on the results screen to jump back in.
tips: Use the Heat HUD chip: Easy buys space, Normal adds pressure, Hard means more rivals are joining.
Cut across a rival's path only after your snake is clearly longer.
Short boosts are safer than holding boost until you hit the minimum length.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys steer, Shift or Space boosts, Esc or P pauses, M mutes.
controls.touch: Drag to steer, tap the top-right pause button for the menu, and use on-screen buttons for restart or tutorial.

difficulty: Adaptive ramp: the Heat HUD moves from Easy to Normal to Hard as your snake grows and more rivals spawn.

cheats.effect: Starts the session with a giant snake body.
Lets the snake ghost through danger and wrap across arena walls.
Keeps boost running without spending length.

features.one-tap-start: Tap Play, then tap the tutorial card button to enter the arena.
features.instant-restart: Play again restarts the arena immediately without reloading.
features.best-score-badge: Best length stays on the title and results screens, with a new-best banner for clean runs.
features.tutorial-card: A single first-run tutorial card teaches steering, survival, and boosting and can be replayed from the menu or arcade pause menu.
features.results: The results screen shows score, best, and a one-tap Play again button.
